Name: Social Valley
Author: Gerik17
Description:
[center][size=6][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/PmpAO4K.png[/img]
🌟 Social Valley - AI-Powered Conversations for Stardew Valley[/b][/size][/center]


[b]Transform your Stardew Valley experience with unlimited, intelligent conversations powered by advanced AI!
[/b]

[size=5][b]✨ What This Mod Does[/b][/size]

Social Valley revolutionizes how you interact with NPCs in Stardew Valley by replacing static dialogue with dynamic, AI-powered conversations. Every character becomes a living, breathing individual with their own personality and emotional responses.

[size=4][b]🗣️ Natural Conversations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Unlimited dialogue[/b] - No more repeated phrases or exhausted conversation trees[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic responses[/b] - NPCs react to weather, seasons, time of day, and your friendship level[/*]
[*][b]Contextual awareness[/b] - Characters notice what you're wearing, carrying, and doing[/*]
[*][b]Personality-driven[/b] - Each character maintains their unique traits and speech patterns[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]🎭 Immersive Roleplay[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Physical interactions[/b] - Give hugs, hold hands, and express affection naturally[/*]
[*][b]Emotional engagement[/b] - NPCs show empathy, offer support, and share their feelings[/*]
[*][b]Relationship building[/b] - Deeper connections through meaningful conversations[/*]
[*][b]Visual context[/b] - NPCs react to what they can actually see and observe[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]🎮 Smart Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Gift system compatible[/b] - Seamlessly works with the existing gift-giving mechanics[/*]
[*][b]Edit conversations[/b] - Modify or regenerate any message in your chat history[/*]
[*][b]Multilingual support[/b] - Automatically adapts to your game's language settings[/*]
[*][b]Anti-repetition system[/b] - NPCs avoid getting stuck on the same topics[/*]
[*][b]Multiple AI providers[/b] - Choose the AI service that works best for you[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]🤖 AI Provider Options[/b][/size]

Social Valley supports multiple AI providers, giving you flexibility in how you power your conversations:

[size=4][b]⭐ Player2 (Recommended)[/b][/size]
Player2 is our recommended choice for the best experience:
[list]
[*][b]Zero configuration[/b] - Desktop app automatically connects[/*]
[*][b]Privacy-focused[/b] - Runs locally on your computer[/*]
[*][b]Easy setup[/b] - No API key management needed[/*]
[*][b]Free to use[/b][/*]
[/list]

[b]Option 1: Desktop App (Easiest)[/b]
[url=https://player2.game/][size=4]📥 Download Player2 Desktop App[/size][/url]

[b]Option 2: API Key[/b]
[url=https://gerikuylerk.com/SocialValley/][size=4]🔑 Generate Player2 API Key Here[/size][/url]

[size=4][b]🔧 Alternative AI Providers[/b][/size]
For advanced users who prefer other AI services:
[list]
[*]OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-3.5)[/*]
[*]Google Gemini[/*]
[*]OpenRouter (Access to multiple models)[/*]
[/list]

Configure your preferred provider in the mod settings menu.

[size=5][b]🚀 Getting Started[/b][/size]

[b]Quick Setup (Recommended):[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://player2.game/]Player2 desktop app[/url][/*]
[*]Install Social Valley through your mod manager[/*]
[*]Start playing - Left-click any NPC to begin chatting![/*]
[/list]

[b]Manual Setup (Advanced):[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Generate an API key from your preferred provider[/*]
[*]Install Social Valley through your mod manager[/*]
[*]Open chat settings and enter your API key[/*]
[*]Select your AI provider and model[/*]
[*]Start chatting![/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]💡 How to Use[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] NPCs for normal Stardew Valley dialogue[/*]
[*][b]Left-click[/b] NPCs to open AI-powered conversations[/*]
[*]Click the [b]⚙️ Settings[/b] icon in chat to configure your AI provider[/*]
[*]Use [b]Edit Mode (✏️)[/b] to modify conversation history[/*]
[*][b]NPCs respond better[/b] when you engage with their interests and personality[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]🎯 Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version)[/*]
[*]An AI provider:
[list]
[*]Player2 (recommended - free & easy)[/*]
[*]OR an API key from OpenAI, Google, or OpenRouter[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]📸 Features Showcase[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Dynamic conversations that adapt to game context[/*]
[*]NPCs with unique personalities and speech patterns[/*]
[*]Context-aware responses based on your actions[/*]
[*]Seamless integration with vanilla game mechanics[/*]
[/list]
